Normative spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.2 instead defines unsigned big-endian epoch, SFN, and timestamp followed by rx_chains, setup_window, occupied_time, 50 ms guard, and channel_mask; current implementations/vectors should use that contract.
